overview.shownNotReference: Measurement outside the morning window or not standard ({date}): it is shown, but it does not enter the comparisons.

prepare.title: Prepare the view
prepare.subtitle: You adjust how it looks, not the data.
prepare.courseStartHint: The starting point is calculated on the first 7 reference days from this date. Empty: from the beginning of the history.
prepare.metricsHint: Add or remove with "Select metrics" in the chart; here you set the order.
prepare.saveView: Save the view for this client
prepare.viewHint: You will find the saved view again, the PDF report uses it and so will the client app.
prepare.annotationsHint: One word on a date: shown in the charts and in the report.
prepare.exclusionsHint: They stay visible as crossed dots and in a note in the report. The reason is required.
prepare.notReady: Annotations, exclusions and the saved view arrive with migration sito-049: until it is applied this part stays off.
prepare.excludedNote: {count, plural, one {# measurement excluded} other {# measurements excluded}}: {reasons}

beforeAfter.startNowSubtitle: Start (average of the first 7 reference days), average of the last 7 days, change and verdict. Standard morning measurements only.
beforeAfter.verdictReal: real change, outside the starting range
beforeAfter.verdictProvisional: indicative, over {n, plural, one {# measurement} other {# measurements}}
beforeAfter.noReference: No reference measurement: standard morning measurements (4 am to 12 pm) are needed. The others stay in the measurement list.
beforeAfter.noPrePost: No before and after pair: in the app choose the "before" tag before the treatment (or workout) and "after" afterwards, on the same day.
beforeAfter.coherenceSubtitle: The morning reference measurement and the coherence session of the same day: how much changes right after guided breathing.
beforeAfter.noCoherencePairs: No morning and coherence pair: a coherence session (guided breathing) on the same day, after the morning measurement, is needed.
